scenes.text: In 2010, one street in Stockholm had a speeding problem.
The limit was thirty. Almost nobody cared.
Bigger fines? Drivers just paid them.
So the city tried something nobody expected.
What if we paid the drivers who slow down?
scenes.speaker: MAYOR

scenes.text: The camera still caught the speeders.
But every driver under the limit got a lottery ticket.

overlay.text: UNDER THE LIMIT? YOU COULD WIN!

scenes.text: And the prize came from the speeders' fines.
The next morning, the street was different.
Average speed dropped from thirty-two to twenty-five.
Same street. Same drivers. One small reward.
Would you slow down for a chance to win?
